title: ElevenLabs Webhook Tools: Connect Your Voice Agent to Any API
desc:
Webhook tools let an ElevenLabs agent call any REST API mid-conversation, with the LLM filling in the parameters. This episode walks through the documented get_weather example step by step: name, description, method and URL, path parameters with the LLM Prompt value type, the tool config file, and the system prompt that orchestrates it. It also covers JSON vs URL-encoded bodies, the five authentication methods, and how to keep API keys out of the prompt.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
